articles.summary: Arteris has been recognized on Fast Company’s 2026 list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, ranking #4 in North America alongside industry leaders like Google, Nvidia, and more. The recognition highlights the company’s leadership in advancing semiconductor innovation, particularly through technologies like FlexGen smart network-on-chip IP and expanded chiplet integration and cybersecurity solutions. With its technology deployed in billions of chips worldwide, Arteris continues to address the growing complexity and security demands of AI-driven silicon design. Learn more in the press release.
articles.title: Arteris Named to Fast Company’s Annual List of the World’s Most Innovative Companies of 2026

articles.summary: Arteris FlexNoC network-on-chip (NoC) interconnect IP has been licensed and deployed by Renesas for its most advanced R-Car Gen 5 SoC series.
articles.title: Arteris Network-on-Chip IP Deployed in Renesas’ Next-Gen R-Car Automotive Technology
